title: Service Level Credit for the Latest Census Month — Credit Percentage and Credit Base
content:
**The month.** The service level credit computed here, under the Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement, is the one the employer claims for the latest month on its census, the census entry with the latest census month.

**The credit.** For the latest census month the service level credit is the credit percentage applied to the credit base and rounded half up to the cent, and no credit is given when that month's measured availability is not below the tier's availability commitment.

**The credit percentage.** The credit percentage is 50 percent where the measured availability is below 95.0 percent, 25 percent where it is below 99.0 percent but not below 95.0 percent, and 10 percent where it is below the tier's availability commitment but not below 99.0 percent.

| Measured availability of the month | Credit percentage |
|---|---|
| below 95.0 | 50 |
| 95.0 or above, below 99.0 | 25 |
| 99.0 or above, below the tier's commitment | 10 |
| at or above the tier's commitment | no credit |

**No platform fee line.** Where the claimed month's invoice carries no platform fee line, as on a tier whose monthly platform fee is zero, or its platform fee line carries billing-error credits equal to its whole amount, no service level credit is given under these provisions.

**The credit base.** The credit base is the amount of that month's platform fee line, after any bundle discount, less any billing-error credit booked against it.

**Order of the figures.** The credit is formed in one fixed order: what is added to the credit base is added first, the credit percentage is then multiplied by each multiplier, and the resulting percentage is applied once to the credit base so formed.

**Payroll Card bundle discount and the credit base.** The Payroll Card bundle discount applies only to the platform fee and never to per-worker, sponsored, implementation, termination or return fee lines, and an SLA credit for the same month is computed on the discounted fee, while the per-worker fee, the early termination fee and the base of the service level credit for the latest census month are each set by their own provisions, the base of the service level credit for the latest census month being the credit base set here.

## Worked figures (hypothetical Enterprise Plus program, commitment 99.9 percent, platform fee line of 2360.00 after its bundle discount, no billing-error credit)

| Measured availability | Credit percentage | Service level credit |
|---|---|---|
| 99.20 | 10 | 236.00 |
| 98.10 | 25 | 590.00 |
| 94.80 | 50 | 1180.00 |
| 99.92 | none | none |

On a hypothetical Growth-tier program, whose monthly platform fee is zero and whose invoice therefore carries no platform fee line, no service level credit is given under these provisions whatever the month's measured availability.
